'''Feydu''' was a [[Evocii]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] warrior who, during the [[Galactic War]], was aboard the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruiser]] [[Gav Daragon (Valor-class)|''Gav Daragon'']].<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Evocii Avenger Feydu was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 2.2, as a Nightmare Force Vendor for Operation: Scum and Villainy,<ref name="Patch">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/2.2/operation-nightmare|text=Game Update 2.2: Operation Nightmare Patch Notes}}</ref> though he was later removed in a reorganizing of endgame gear.<ref name="TOR" />
